conditions: Holotype ZSI-R-27672, adult male, of Hemidactylus kalinga sp. nov. (type material from Kalinga Ghati, Kandhamal District, Odisha, India, as printed in the same paper). The pupil is described for the holotype only; the Diagnosis, Variations and Comparison sections do not mention the pupil. The pupil clause sits inside a longer sentence on the eye and supraciliaries.
